title: Notification preferences
description: A configurable preference form, validated TypeScript domain model, Fetch API client, and authenticated Request/Response adapter with injected atomic persistence.

notes: UI requires React 18 or 19, React types, and a TypeScript/TSX pipeline.
Core is framework-neutral. Server adapter uses the Fetch Request/Response APIs available in Node.js 22+.
Import the included stylesheet explicitly; no CSS loader or persistence provider is assumed.

configuration: Declare 1–32 stable preference keys, labels, allowed email/push/inApp channels, and explicit defaults; omitted defaults are false.
Inject a persistent store implementing atomic compareAndSet and read, scoped to authenticated subject and tenant.
Inject application authentication/authorization and configure exact allowedOrigins; PUT fails closed without an allowed Origin.
Mount the form with schema, initialSnapshot, and save callback; remount when authenticated identity or schema changes.
Import notification-preferences.css explicitly and map its documented CSS variables to the project Brand Kit.
limitations: Does not send notifications, enroll push devices, provision services, or imply a marketing consent system.
Requires real authorization and persistent transaction adapters; the module has no default storage.
Origin checks supplement the receiving application's session/CSRF policy and are not authentication.
Schema changes require a project-owned data migration; existing records are validated against the exact current schema.
Production database correctness, session security, delivery integration, and consuming application acceptance remain project responsibilities.
decisions: GET returns defaults with revision 0; PUT replaces the whole document, no PATCH
stale revision with different values → 409 with current snapshot; an identical PUT is unchanged
channels limited to email, push, inApp; 1-32 types
PUT body JSON only (415 otherwise), max 16,384 bytes; adapter failures → 503
options: schema channels: which of email/push/inApp each type offers; defaults: per-channel default (default false)
